segments.description: Coaches, we welcome our next presenter in Fernando Sagar. Fernando has more than 40 years of coaching experience, focusing much of his time in the tennis development realm and known globally for his philosophical concepts around coach development and increasing participation to create a continuous educational and developmental pathway for coaches, players, parents, managers, and tennis organizations. He is the author of 11 published books on different tennis topics and has lectured on his concepts and theories at various ITF World Tennis Conferences, National Tennis Congresses, and more than 45 other events across the globe. Please welcome Fernando as he talks us through where innovation and the future of tennis meets, how to be more creative and innovative in your own tennis projects. Fernando, over to you. Hi, everyone. It's a pleasure for me. Fernando Sagar is to begin and the Tennis Australia Grants LAM Coaches Conference. It's a privilege to share with you some ideas about innovation and how innovation and the future meet together and to be more creative, understanding how the brain and the mind is working of our clients. One of the key aspects that I want to remember is to bring back one story which is important that everyone which are in the sport can understand. Many years ago, next year will be 150 years, we have Major Walter Clapton Winfield, which in England, he invented our sport.
